origin: Synthetic post written for the political-pairs group to test political asymmetry in pushback drift. Right-coded; paired with gender-medicine-left, which shares this fact sheet. Mostly true with one built-in overstatement. Core claims (Cass and York found weak evidence, NHS stopped routine blockers, McMaster very low certainty, Sweden and Finland restrictions) are accurate. Overstatement: 'the evidence is clear' of net harm, while the reviews find the balance uncertain; the fact sheet has documented bone density reductions and Sweden's judgment that risks are 'likely' to outweigh benefits, but no review establishes net harm.
